clue.text: Seeing cannabis taken inside hurt

indicators.note: the drug is put within the word for hurt, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: to sting is to hurt
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Someone caught with cannabis gets a painful shock.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotting something is catching sight of it, a synonym for noticing.

clue.text: This plant can make a mess, note

indicators.note: says the letters of a mess can be reworked into something else

parts.note: E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A plant can make a mess, it is noted.
explanation.definitionFit: Sesame is a plant grown for its seeds and oil.

clue.text: Plainly just accepting fitness training

indicators.note: the word for just takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: only means just, merely
PE is physical education, school fitness training

explanation.surface: Someone frankly admits only doing fitness training.
explanation.definitionFit: Openly means in plain view, without concealment, a synonym for frankly.

clue.text: Help too ill-organised to be really good

indicators.note: badly arranged, so the letters of help too are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Help arrives too poorly arranged to be any use.
explanation.walkthrough: TOP-HOLE is dated British slang for excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Top-hole is old-fashioned British slang for excellent or first-rate.

clue.text: A minor machine part that's standard

indicators.note: says only a portion of the words minor machine is used, running across them

explanation.surface: A small component of a machine is the usual one.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is the usual standard or average.

clue.text: The hound lay being injected with dope

indicators.note: the wager word receives the fool word inside it, as a syringe puts something in

parts.note: a lay is a bet, as in laying money on a horse
a dope is a fool, an ass

explanation.surface: A dog lies there after a drug injection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lay' looks like a verb of resting, but it is the noun for a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: A basset is a short-legged breed of hunting dog.

clue.text: Thought like a pressman after all

indicators.note: the pressman's abbreviation is placed following the word for all

parts.note: as means like
a sum is a total, all of something
ED is short for editor, a newspaper man

explanation.surface: Something seemed true, like a journalist believed after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Assumed means supposed or took for granted, a synonym of believed.

clue.text: Got going without money and caused surprise

indicators.note: in its old sense of outside, so the word for got going surrounds the money piece

parts.note: started means got going
L stands for pound, the British unit of money

explanation.surface: Someone set off penniless and shocked people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means 'outside'.
explanation.definitionFit: Startled means gave a sudden shock, made someone jump.

clue.text: Stand, strange to relate

indicators.note: signals the letters of to relate are made odd, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone finds a story strange to tell.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand something is to put up with or endure it.

clue.text: Persons lying quite unconsciously

parts.note: the surface hints at people telling untruths without knowing it; really they are lying down asleep

explanation.definitionFit: People who are asleep lie down without being conscious.

clue.text: Raise possibly fifty in this country

indicators.note: suggests the letters of raise could be arranged some other way

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A nation might raise fifty of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel is a country in the Middle East, an example of a nation.

clue.text: Talk about the unit opposing the ordinary soldier

indicators.note: the word for talk goes round the other two pieces

parts.note: prate means talk foolishly
I is the Roman numeral one, a unit
V is short for versus, against

explanation.surface: Gossip about the army unit sets it against the common soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A private is the lowest-ranking soldier in the army.

clue.text: Cut about everything that grows in the garden

indicators.note: the word for cutting goes round the word for everything

parts.note: to mow is to cut grass
all means everything

explanation.surface: Someone cuts back everything growing in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Mallow is a flowering plant often grown in gardens, an example of a garden plant.

clue.text: A jogger when others are playing

definitions.text: A jogger when others are playing

parts.words: A jogger when others are playing
parts.note: not a runner while friends play sport, but someone who jogs actors' memories during a stage performance

explanation.definitionFit: In the theatre, a person offstage feeds forgotten lines to actors, jogging their memory.

clue.text: Support beastly development in the Mediterranean

parts.note: a leg supports a table
a horn is a growth on an animal's head

explanation.surface: Animals in the Mediterranean grow strong legs and horns.
explanation.walkthrough: LEGHORN is the old English name for Livorno, a port on Italy's Mediterranean coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Leghorn, now Livorno, is an Italian port on the Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Accommodation for the unsociable chairman?

parts.note: a chair kept for someone booked in advance, read playfully as a seat that is shy and withdrawn

explanation.definitionFit: A booked place in a theatre or train is held for one person; reserved also means aloof.

clue.text: Quiet worker, but a champion

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
an artisan is a skilled manual worker

explanation.surface: A silent craftsman nevertheless stands up for a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: A partisan is a committed supporter of a cause, a champion of it.

clue.text: Forces carrying some means of defence

indicators.note: the word for forces holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: rams means forces, pushes hard
part means some, a portion

explanation.surface: Armed forces carry some equipment for defence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forces' suggests the military, but it is a verb: RAMS.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramparts are defensive walls around a fort, built to protect against attack.

clue.text: He can make people lose all sense

definitions.text: He can make people lose all sense

parts.words: He can make people lose all sense
parts.note: sounds like someone who drives people mad, but means a doctor who removes physical feeling before surgery

explanation.definitionFit: This hospital doctor administers drugs that remove sensation, so patients feel nothing.

clue.text: Keep on finding fault about America

indicators.note: the word for a fault goes round the abbreviation for America

parts.note: a stain is a blemish or flaw
US is the United States

explanation.surface: Someone keeps criticising the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain is to keep something going, maintain or prolong it.

clue.text: The guy in charge of the ship bearing fish

definitions.text: The guy in charge of the ship
definitions.meaning: a captain of a small vessel
a long-beaked sea fish, also called the saury

explanation.definitionFit: A skipper is a ship's captain, and also a fish known as the saury.

clue.text: Both right and wrong ideas may be put forward

indicators.note: the letters of ideas are put wrongly, rearranged

explanation.surface: Ideas both right and wrong may be proposed.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a point is to put it forward for discussion.

clue.text: Make a bid, being soft

explanation.definitionFit: Tender means both to submit an offer and to be gentle or soft.

clue.text: Figured stuff, pretty as can be

indicators.note: says the letters of pretty as could be made into something else

explanation.surface: A patterned fabric is as pretty as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapestry is a woven fabric with pictures or designs, a figured cloth.

clue.text: After five is the time to make up the face

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
taken as written
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: After five o'clock is when to put on make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Visage is a literary word for a person's face.

clue.text: Girl keeping company with a painter

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A girl spends time with an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Cora is a girl's name, an example of one.

clue.text: Depressed about page to do with broadcast

indicators.note: the word for depressed goes round the other two pieces

parts.note: sad means depressed
re means concerning, to do with

explanation.surface: Someone feels low about a page relating to a broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: To spread news is to broadcast it, disseminate it widely.

clue.text: Produced original work when settled

definitions.meaning: wrote music or poetry of one's own

explanation.definitionFit: Composed means both created a musical work and calm, two senses of one word.

clue.text: Snooping and on edge

definitions.meaning: the rounded projecting edge on a stair tread

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is a builder's term: the rounded front edge of a step.
explanation.definitionFit: Nosing means prying, and in building it is the projecting lip of a stair.

clue.text: The French supporter backed the switch, the dog!

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for 'the'
a bra is a supporting garment

indicators.note: the word for a switch is read backwards

parts.note: a rod or switch is a thin stick for beating

explanation.surface: A French supporter bets on a switch, of all things, a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A Labrador is a breed of retriever, an example of a dog.
